title: Vulnerability Mitigation System (VMS): LLM Agent and Evaluation Framework for Autonomous Penetration Testing
reasoning: The paper focuses on cybersecurity, specifically autonomous penetration testing and performance benchmarking of LLMs on Capture The Flag (CTF) challenges. It does not evaluate or benchmark religion, faith, morals, or ethics; discussions on 'safety' are limited to technical containment (containerization) and operational reliability.
